description: Signed-off fallback-mutation target set (KR7.3). This file is the single source of truth for WHICH representative targets the release-blocking mutation gate runs and how many deterministic mutants each must carry. Per-mutant expectations and score floors live with each target in fallback/<target>/<target>.target.json. Adding a target, or removing one, is a reviewed edit here; silently dropping a target directory cannot shrink the gate.
